capacity_selection.quantization_tradeoff: Extremely low-bit IQ1_S; fit and readable output must be measured, not inferred from file size.
larger_or_higher_precision_exclusions: Inspected Qwen3 235B Instruct Unsloth Q2_K: 85,691,001,472 bytes exceeds physical RAM.
Inspected Qwen3.5 397B Unsloth IQ1_M: 106,819,877,056 bytes exceeds physical RAM.
Qwen235 Thinking IQ2_XXS ~61.9 GB leaves inadequate reserve within default Metal recommendation.
Qwen235 Thinking IQ1_M ~53.14 GB leaves little GPU runtime/KV headroom under 55.66 GB recommendation; choose IQ1_S for useful bounded context.
capacity_selection.scope: Selected current public artifacts, not proof of absolute largest across models/quantizations.
